description: This file defines the 'InterviewAttachment' entity class for a Human Resource Management system, representing attachments associated with interviews in the recruitment module. It includes properties such as file metadata, content, and associations with an interview.

classes.name: InterviewAttachment
classes.description: An ORM-mapped entity class representing an attachment linked to a job interview, including properties for file details and relational mapping to the Interview entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates this attachment with a specific Interview.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file, if set.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content, either as a resource or string.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the attachment type as an integer, if set.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the attachment.
